title: Capability state register (frozen v0.1)
description: Authoritative shape of packages/contracts/data/capabilities.json. Status: FROZEN v0.1 (Phase 03, 2026-10-20). The SHAPE is frozen; the DATA may change later (Phase 08), and only by flipping a state and recording the evidence that justified it. Every capability carries an explicit state, and a capability that is not validated must say how it is rendered instead — `insufficient_evidence` is the honest rendering for a missing or unvalidated measurement, never a zero and never a fabricated number. `goalPreserved` records that a capability's product goal is still in scope even while it is unvalidated: narrowing a goal is a scope change that needs the owner's explicit approval, not a data edit. `acceptance` records the thresholds a later validation must meet, so a state flip is checkable rather than asserted.

capabilityVersion.description: Contract version of this register's shape. Bumped only through a Phase 03-style contract review.

checkedOn.description: Date the states below were last checked against the evidence they cite.

capabilities.description: The closed set of product capabilities and their states.

source.description: Where the state was decided: either a public URL or a repository path to the evidence document.

capabilityState.description: unvalidated = no passing check exists; validated_synthetic_only = the check passed only on generated signals, which proves the mechanism and not natural-learner behaviour; validated = a genuine check against real audio with held-out labels met the recorded acceptance thresholds.

renderedState.description: How the UI and the coach must render this capability right now. An unvalidated capability is rendered as insufficient_evidence, never as a zero, a score or a fabricated number.

metrics.description: The metric keys this capability produces. Empty means the capability produces no metric at all.

unavailabilityReason.description: The reason code written with the metric when the capability cannot produce a value.

goal.description: The product goal this capability serves, stated so that a data change cannot quietly narrow it.

goalPreserved.description: True while the goal is still in scope even though the capability is unvalidated. Narrowing a goal is a scope change that needs the owner's explicit approval.

scopeChangeApproved.description: True only when the owner has explicitly approved narrowing or dropping this capability. False means the goal still stands and the honest rendering is insufficient_evidence.

validatedAt.description: The date the capability was validated; null while it is not. A later validated state fills this field — the data field reserved for that flip.

validatedBy.description: Who or what validated it, in plain words. Null while it is not validated.

evidenceRefs.description: Paths or URLs of the evidence behind the state.

acceptance.description: The thresholds a later validation must meet, so that flipping the state is checkable rather than asserted.

notes.description: Plain-word limitations, written by the project, never copied from learner or model text.
